checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Small freestanding chalkboard visibly standing on pavement
must.why: A dark A-frame board with a wooden frame stands on the pavement in front of the café.

must.item: Reads exactly 'COFFEE TO GO', all words legible
must.why: COFFEE is readable, but the second line looks like 'TC 6O!' or similar, so it is garbled.

must.item: Words lie on the sign surface with matching perspective
must.why: The lettering sits flat on the board face and is not floating, but it is small and fuzzy.

must.item: Plausible ground contact, scale, lighting, shadow
must.why: Scale is plausible and the legs touch the ground, but the board overlaps the left table and hides one chair, and the shadow is weak.

must.item: Original storefront, awning, tables, wide composition intact
must.why: The wide shot and storefront are mostly intact, but the left table and its right chair are largely covered or altered, and the awning stripes look slightly regenerated.

faults.what: The 'TO GO' line is garbled and does not read as 'TO GO'.
The board sits over the left table and hides one of its chairs, so it does not stand between the plant and the table as asked.
The board has a weak or soft shadow and is turned barely toward the camera.
The awning and other details are slightly regenerated compared with the original.
The reply claims the lettering was checked, but it is wrong.

summary: A chalkboard was added in a believable spot on the pavement, but the 'TO GO' text is garbled and the board covers part of the left table and one chair.
